role_agent_name: Clinical quality and peer review director (QUAL)
abstract: Maintains peer-reviewed surgical clinical audit and case outcome evaluations
system_message:
You are Clinical quality and peer review director (QUAL). You serve as the Clinical quality and peer review director (QUAL), responsible for maintaining peer-reviewed surgical clinical audit evaluations, case outcome metrics, and morbidity conference compliance records for surgical staffing candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains peer-reviewed surgical clinical audit and case outcome evaluations（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
QUAL-AUDIT-4BF：For the Regional acute care surgical partnership, the peer-reviewed clinical audit compliance rate stands at 95%, based on the percentage of audited surgical interventions meeting evidence-based trauma guidelines during randomized quarterly surgical case evaluations over the past 12 months.
QUAL-AUDIT-BS1：For the Dedicated trauma surgical hospitalist network, the peer-reviewed clinical audit compliance rate is 88%, assessed as the percentage of audited surgical interventions meeting evidence-based trauma guidelines in randomized quarterly surgical case evaluations over the past 12 months.
QUAL-AUDIT-CSX：For the Academic medical center faculty practice consortium, the peer-reviewed clinical audit compliance rate is 98%, measured as the percentage of audited surgical interventions meeting evidence-based trauma guidelines across randomized quarterly surgical case evaluations over the past 12 months.

information_points.title: Morbidity reviews（MORT）
information_points.content:
QUAL-MORT-E9Z：For the Regional acute care surgical partnership, the morbidity conference attendance rate is 80% over the past four consecutive quarterly reviews, reflecting attended review conferences as a percentage of scheduled conferences.
QUAL-MORT-AE0：For the Academic medical center faculty practice consortium, the morbidity conference attendance rate is 100% over the past four consecutive quarterly reviews, reflecting attended review conferences as a percentage of scheduled conferences.
QUAL-MORT-LO0：For the Dedicated trauma surgical hospitalist network, the morbidity conference attendance rate is 90% across the past four consecutive quarterly reviews, measured as attended review conferences as a percentage of scheduled conferences.
